depts.msum: Three groups hold the big houses on the cited pages. Richemont’s jewellery maisons (Cartier, Van Cleef & Arpels, Buccellati, Vhernier) made €16.5 billion in the year to March 2026, against €22.4 billion for the whole group. LVMH reports Tiffany, bought in 2021, and Bulgari, bought in 2011, with Chaumet (1999) inside a Watches & Jewelry division of €10.49 billion in 2025. Kering formed Kering Jewelry for Boucheron, Pomellato (bought 2013), DoDo and Qeelin; the cited article gives no revenue. Outside the luxury groups: Pandora (DKK 32.5 billion, 2025), Chow Tai Fook (HK$94.4 billion, year to March 2026), Signet (US$6.70 billion, 2025) and Swarovski (€2.7 billion, 2020). Independents named in the houses section are Messika, Chopard and David Yurman. No fetched page gave a share of the whole jewellery market, so none is shown.
